advice: Abstain. The current K loop already reuses each loaded FP32 vector across its two applicable FMOPA operations: z0/z1 feed ZA0/ZA2 and ZA1/ZA3, while z2/z3 feed ZA0/ZA1 and ZA2/ZA3. The second row-half loop has different A values, so sharing its accumulations would require holding both row halves at once. That needs more than the four supplied ZA.S tiles; I cannot assume extra tiles exist or substitute a different experiment.
risks: A proposed reuse change without a distinct legal source change would repeat the current behavior or require an unsupported accumulator layout. No performance effect is established.
